wordsStep.title: Learn 5 workspace words
wordsStep.subtitle: These words help you talk about work

words.definition: A planned discussion at work.
words.example: We have a meeting at 10 AM.

words.definition: The last day to finish work.
A written summary of work.
The person who leads your team.
The place where you work.
words.example: I work in a small office.

sentencesStep.title: Practice work sentences
sentencesStep.subtitle: Choose the correct word to complete sentence

questions.prompt: I have a ________ with my manager.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: Can you join the meeting at 10?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Yes, I can join the meeting.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: Great. Please bring the report.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Sure, I will bring the report.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: Thank you. We will discuss the deadline.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Sounds good. I will be ready.

introItems.title: 3 key sentences
introItems.subtitle: Asking for help during a test

wordsStep.title: Learn 5 exam words
wordsStep.subtitle: These words help you on test day

words.definition: A plan that shows when things happen.
To sign up officially for something.
words.example: I registered for the IELTS test.

words.definition: A person taking an exam.
words.example: Each candidate needs an ID card.

words.definition: Directions that tell you what to do.
The score or outcome of a test.
words.example: My result will arrive next week.

sentencesStep.title: Practice exam sentences
sentencesStep.subtitle: Choose the correct word to complete sentence

questions.prompt: Please ________ for the test before Friday.
Every ________ must bring a photo ID.
Follow the ________ on the first page.

lines.speaker: Staff
lines.text: Good morning. Are you here to register?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Yes, I want to register for the speaking test.

lines.speaker: Staff
lines.text: Sure. The schedule is on the screen behind you.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Thank you. When will the result be ready?

lines.speaker: Staff
lines.text: Results are usually sent within seven days.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Great. I will check my email.

words.definition: To request a place or position formally.
To meet the requirements for something.
Knowledge gained from doing something.
Something you are good at.

wordsStep.title: Learn 5 academic words
wordsStep.subtitle: These words help in writing tasks

words.definition: To study something in detail.
words.example: Analyze the chart before you write.

words.definition: Facts that support an idea.
What you think about a topic.
words.example: In my opinion, education is important.

words.definition: The final part that sums up ideas.
The subject you write or talk about.
words.example: Choose one topic from the list.

dialogueStep.subtitle: Read a short discussion about an essay

lines.speaker: Tutor
lines.text: What topic did you choose?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I chose online learning.

lines.speaker: Tutor
lines.text: Did you include enough evidence?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Yes, I added two examples.

lines.speaker: Tutor

lessons.title: Exam English Basics
lessons.subtitle: Review test-day phrases for confidence and clarity.

wordsStep.title: Learn 5 review words
wordsStep.subtitle: These words help you stay confident

words.definition: To make sure something is correct.
To make something easier to understand.
To hand in your work officially.
words.example: Submit your answer sheet at the end.

words.definition: To get ready for something.
Feeling sure about your ability.
words.example: Stay confident during the speaking test.

sentencesStep.title: Practice review sentences
sentencesStep.subtitle: Choose the correct word to complete sentence

questions.prompt: Can you ________ the time of my speaking test?
I did not understand. Could you ________?
Please ________ your paper before you leave.

lines.speaker: Examiner
lines.text: Do you understand the task?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Could you clarify the second question?

lines.speaker: Examiner
lines.text: Yes. Please compare both options.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Thank you. I feel more confident now.

lines.speaker: Examiner
lines.text: Good. You may begin when ready.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Great. I am ready to start.
